OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Stored and returned in E.164 form
            (a leading '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, e.g. '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+?[0-9]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-08-10'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true

The create-owner endpoint (`POST /api/owners`) now rejects a request whose owner would duplicate an existing owner's **last name + address** (compared case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed), responding **409**, unless the request opts in with `sharesHousehold: true`.

Changes:

It canonicalizes last name and address (`trim` → collapse `\s+` to a single space → lower-case), scans existing owners for a match, and throws `DuplicateHouseholdException` on a collision. When `sharesHousehold` is true it short-circuits and allows the create.

3. **`DuplicateHouseholdException`** (checked, `extends Exception`) + **`DuplicateHouseholdExceptionHandler`** — the handler responds `409 CONFLICT`, mirroring the existing `DuplicateTelephoneException` pair.

5. **`owners.POST.yml`** — inserted the `ensureUniqueHousehold` step (under `transaction` governance, consistent with the surrounding steps) between the telephone-uniqueness check and `build`.

This follows the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions — no `@RestController`/`@Transactional`/`@ControllerAdvice`.
